Independent coordinate translations and diagonal dilations give Anosov-like affine actions

Everywhere-hyperbolic dynamics proposed as a useful class

repair.content:
Restrict the criterion and separately prove on-leaf, constant and mixed-subsequence cases at every extension stage.

Construct and verify a different asymmetry, including compatibility with subsequent gluings.

Use a coupled translation (1,1), faithful Laurent-polynomial module, and independent dilations. Report verifies all axioms, density, equal spectra and nonconjugacy.

Exclude degenerate compact sets and specify nondegenerate segments; adequacy of the revised definition remains unproved.
